[ASSISTANT_SAID] Suggested tips for managing IBS include:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Keep a food diary to identify triggers for IBS symptoms.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Eat smaller, more frequent meals to regulate digestion and prevent discomfort.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Stay hydrated by drinking plenty of water and avoiding alcohol and caffeine.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 4. Avoid common trigger foods such as fatty, fried, or processed foods, dairy, spicy foods, and caffeine.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 5. Practice relaxation techniques like meditation, deep breathing, or yoga to manage stress.
